$UNI  will rise to $675! Is it credible?
Today I came across a pretty crazy UNI valuation model. I ran the math, and surprisingly it checks out mathematically!

Someone projected UNI’s terminal market cap to be between $500B and $800B, with a center value around $600B.
The logic is actually quite simple:
If in the future stocks, US Treasuries, funds, FX, repos, and other traditional financial assets are truly moved onto the chain at massive scale, Uniswap won’t be just a token-swapping DEX anymore. It will become on-chain liquidity infrastructure + a gateway for financial asset trading.

The model assumes Uniswap ultimately captures about $4.15T in on-chain transaction volume, and then applies value capture at 0.3 bp—so that comes to about $12.45B per year.
If you also factor in potential value capture from aggregation, MEV, Unichain, and other sources, the model lands around $15B.

$15B ÷ 2.5% long-term burn yield = $600B in market cap.
That market cap implies the price of $UNI  is roughly $675!!! And it still doesn’t account for supply reduction from continuous burning!!!

Of course, brothers, pay attention: this doesn’t mean UNI is definitely worth $600B. This is a very aggressive terminal scenario.
What we can truly confirm right now is that Uniswap has started linking protocol fees to the UNI burning mechanism, and that the fees from products like V2/V3/V4 are also flowing into this value-capture framework.

What really excites me is:
If, in the future, financial assets are moved on-chain at massive scale, what UNI captures might not be anywhere near today’s market size.
Right now everyone is still debating whether $UNI  can return to the previous high.
But if you zoom the timeline out to after on-chain finance fully matures…
then when you look back at today’s price, it might be a completely different story.
So now I increasingly dislike chasing things that everyone has already started shouting about.
The real big opportunities are often when the market still doesn’t fully believe it!

📰 Why Binance’s move this time could actually not involve the crypto circle?

Binance announced that it will distribute an airdrop reward of SpaceX and Nasdaq ETFs to holders of Marscoin (MARSCOIN) and Mar a (MARA). But note: this airdrop is for token holders. Binance is only serving as the distribution channel; the actual airdrop is initiated by the project team. This move has limited direct impact on the overall crypto market. It’s more like a case of cross-market interaction between traditional finance and the crypto space.

Why is this news important?
The core value of this news is that it shows increasing interaction between cryptocurrencies and traditional financial markets. SpaceX and QQQ are iconic symbols in the U.S. stock market. Linking them with crypto airdrops may be intended to attract more traditional investors’ attention to crypto assets. More importantly, it reflects the crypto community learning from—and replicating—reward mechanisms used in traditional finance, such as using airdrops to retain users. This means the competitive tactics in crypto are diversifying: shifting from early, pure speculation toward more refined user relationship management.

Impact on the market
The direct impact on BTC and ETH is almost zero. The core narratives in the crypto market remain within their own domain—whale behavior, on-chain data, regulatory developments, and so on. What does this event imply? It suggests that crypto’s incentive methods may be converging toward traditional finance, and that more cross-border airdrops like “hold XXX coin to receive XX market assets” could appear in the future. However, in the short term, it won’t change BTC/ETH fundamentals, because the airdrop funding size is completely not in the same order of magnitude as traditional markets.

💡 This news affects BTC and ETH more on the sentiment level. It may make some traditional finance investors feel like “crypto is copying our airdrop playbook.” But the real effect depends on the airdrop size. If, in the future, we see a large-scale “crypto coins swapped for Nasdaq ETF airdrops,” then it would be worth taking seriously. If the airdrop scale is so small it’s essentially negligible, it would have almost no impact on the price trends of BTC $83.1K and ETH $2.65. If SpaceX later has major positive catalysts (e.g., a successful first flight of Starship), this kind of cross-market linkage could produce slight synergy—but it will most likely be a one-off event.

If similar events emerge in the future, but the airdrop size reaches the $1M+ level, or involves more sensitive assets such as Bitcoin ETFs, then this judgment would no longer hold.

[Author style]
Data-driven: Binance’s actions are just a channel. The key impact is that the crypto community’s incentive mechanisms are becoming “traditionalized.” Right now, both the airdrop size and its relevance are too weak.

📰 为什么币安这次的操作，加密圈反而可能不沾边？

币安宣布将为火星币（MARSCOIN）和牛来（MARA）持币者发放SpaceX和纳斯达克ETF的空投奖励。但注意，这个空投是给持有代币的用户，币安只是作为分发渠道，实际空投由项目方发起。这次操作对整个加密市场的直接影响有限，更像是一个传统金融市场和加密圈的跨市场互动案例。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条新闻的核心价值在于它展示了加密货币与传统金融市场之间日益增多的互动。SpaceX和QQQ是美股市场的标志性符号，将它们与加密空投结合，可能是为了吸引更多传统投资者关注加密资产。但更重要的是，它反映了加密圈正在学习并复制传统金融市场的激励玩法，比如通过空投留住用户。这意味着加密圈的竞争手段正在多元化，从早期的纯粹炒作转向更精细的用户关系维护。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的直接影响几乎为零。加密市场的核心叙事仍在自身范畴内，比如鲸鱼行为、链上数据、监管进展等。这次事件意味着什么？它暗示加密圈的激励手段可能正在向传统金融靠拢，未来可能出现更多"持有XXX币可以获得XX市场资产"的跨界空投。但短期内，它不会改变BTC/ETH的基本面，因为空投的资金规模与传统市场比完全不在一个量级。

💡 这次新闻对BTC和ETH的影响更多是情绪层面。它可能会让部分传统金融投资者觉得"加密也学我们搞空投了"，但实际效果需要看空投规模。如果未来出现大规模的"加密币换纳斯达克ETF空投"，那才值得大做文章。如果空投规模小到可以忽略不计，那对BTC $83.1K和ETH $2.65的走势几乎没有影响。如果SpaceX后续有重大利好（比如星舰首飞成功），这种跨界联动可能会产生轻微的协同效应，但大概率是昙花一现。

如果未来出现类似事件，但空投规模达到$1M+美元级别，或者涉及比特币ETF等更敏感资产，这个判断作废。

【作者风格】数据导向：币安的操作只是一个渠道，核心影响是加密圈激励手段正在传统化。目前空投规模和关联性都太弱。

【Ethereum is “killing itself,” then being reborn—but not many people understand】

Yesterday, Vitalik said something, and mainstream media either chanted it like a slogan or didn’t take it seriously at all.

"Starting now, Ethereum is no longer just a blockchain—it’s something far more powerful."

To be honest, a decade ago when I first got into this industry, I’d heard so many statements like this. But this time it’s different. I verified that this signal is real, and it’s very likely being severely underestimated by the market.

Why?

Look at the data these days—ETH $ 2658, down 1.2% over 24 hours, and almost unchanged over 7 days. The Fear & Greed Index is 74, greed. In this kind of moment, most people focus on the candlestick chart for direction, waiting for a breakout or a breakdown.

But what truly matters isn’t the price.

What Vitalik mentioned—PeerDAS—put simply, is to stop every computer on the network from repeating the same calculations. That sounds technical, but if you think it through: if this works, Ethereum won’t be just a “chain” anymore—it will become a world-class encrypted computing machine. Whoever can build applications on top of this will capture the next wave of infrastructure upside.

What happens on the ground? Developers will flood in, because the cost and efficiency will be far better than traditional cloud services. DeFi, NFTs, and even the AI applications that are hot right now could all migrate to this new computing layer. At that point, Ethereum’s value anchor won’t be only Gas fees, but the computing demand of the entire ecosystem.

Of course there are risks—whether the technology can be delivered on time, whether regulation will interfere. But these are hurdles that all new technologies have to clear, and they don’t affect whether the logic itself holds.

From the 46% retracement level off the ATH, long-term capital has already started looking. Historically, this zone isn’t a top—it’s an opportunity area.

I’m not saying you should rush in and go all-in right now. But I’m willing to call this Alpha: in the next cycle, Ethereum’s value logic will be restructured. People who understand it early will have the advantage.

Can this actually get implemented? What do you think?

content:
【以太坊正在“杀死”自己，然后重生——但没几个人看懂】

昨天V神说了句话，主流媒体要么当口号念，要么压根没当回事。

"从此刻起，Ethereum不再是区块链，而是一个更强大的东西。"

说实话，十年前我刚接触这行，也听过太多类似的话。但这次不一样，我验证下来这个信号是真的，而且很可能被市场严重低估了。

为什么？

你们看这几天数据——ETH $ 2658，24小时跌了1.2%，7天几乎没动。恐惧贪婪指数74，贪婪区。这种时候大多数人盯着K线看方向，等着突破或者跌破。

但真正值得关注的根本不在价格。

V神提到的PeerDAS，简单说就是让网络上每台电脑不再重复做一样的计算。这听着技术，但你往深了想——如果这个跑通了，Ethereum就不再是个“链”，而是一台世界级的加密计算机。谁能在这上面搭建应用，谁就拿到了下一波的基础设施红利。

落地层面会发生什么？开发者会大量涌入，因为成本和效率都比传统云服务强太多。DeFi、NFT、甚至现在火热的AI应用，都可能迁移到这个新计算层。到时候ETH的价值锚定就不再只是Gas费，而是整个生态的算力需求。

风险当然有——技术能不能按时交付？监管会不会来搅局？但这些是所有新技术都要过的坎，不影响逻辑本身成立。

从ATH回撤46%这个位置，长线资金已经开始看了，这片区域历史上不是顶部，是机会区。

我不是说现在就要冲进去梭哈。但这个Alpha我愿意说——下一个周期，以太坊的价值逻辑会重构，现在看懂的人会占优势。

这东西能不能真落地，你怎么看？
